summary: Iteration 6 full-stack verification of iteration-5 features (activity feed, meal planner, transfer ownership, skip-next). Backend: 12/12 new tests pass in test_iteration5.py AND 14/14 prior iteration-4 regression tests still green (zero regressions). Frontend: dashboard renders cleanly with MealPlannerCard (7x4=28 add slots), FamilyCard and CalendarCard all mounted; meal create + Send-to-shop end-to-end works (success toast shown, ingredients appear on shopping list, footer correctly reads '1 meal planned · 3 unique ingredients'). Version endpoint confirms 1.2.

minor.issue: Exception silently swallowed (bare except Exception: pass). Fine for best-effort but hides bugs; consider logging.warning on failure.
No validation that end_date >= start_date; invalid range still returns 200 with added=0 — acceptable but consider 400 for clarity.
@app.on_event('shutdown') still uses deprecated FastAPI decorator (carried from earlier iterations).

issues: Radix console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Not blocking; same a11y gap as the CheckoutMode dialog flagged in iteration 4/5. Consider adding <DialogDescription> (or VisuallyHidden) to MealPlannerCard dialogs.

action_items: OPTIONAL low-pri: add <DialogDescription>/VisuallyHidden to the two dialogs in MealPlannerCard.jsx (meal edit + send-to-shop) and to CheckoutMode dialog to clear the Radix a11y console warnings.
OPTIONAL: return 400 on POST /api/meals/to-shopping when end_date < start_date for clearer client errors.
OPTIONAL: log exceptions inside log_activity() instead of silent pass.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/meals/to-shopping correctly dedupes ingredients case-insensitively via seen_lower set, strips empties, updates frequent_items counter, and invokes log_activity. Verified with mixed-case ingredient list ['Onion', 'garlic', 'Chicken', 'onion', 'rice', ''] -> added=4 unique.

POST /api/family/transfer-ownership enforces all three guards as specified: 403 non-owner, 400 self-transfer, 404 target-not-in-family. Happy path flips is_owner on both docs atomically and is reversible. All 4 transfer tests pass.
GET /api/activity supports since-filter via $gt on ISO string (works because all created_at values use consistent UTC ISO-with-offset format). Sort desc confirmed.
MealCreate model persists all required fields (date, meal_type, name, ingredients, notes). Meal list filter by start_date/end_date uses $gte/$lte correctly.

Frontend: MealPlannerCard uses Fragment-compatible grid rendering (no crash on mount); activity poller (30s) + reminder poller correctly deduplicate own-user activity (observed: zero self-toasts during test session).
Defensive is_owner backfill in GET /api/family/members still in place (lines ~452-454). Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke - dashboard loads, meal CRUD + send-to-shop integrated end-to-end, owner badges render, zero PageErrors
